name: pattern_idempotent_recurring_self-heal_60d836
claim: Core lesson of the gbrain self-heal journey; applies beyond gbrain.

decisions.notes: Meta-durability principle from gbrain self-heal: recurring rot = fixes kept as knowledge + deferred removals; close the loop by converting manual fixes into idempotent self-heal wired into startup and completing archival/removal in the same pass. Applies beyond gbrain.
